bias.en: Rebound fading · lost the 10-day, SAR still bullish
bias.zh: 反弹减弱 · 跌破 10 日均线，SAR 仍看多

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS fell 5.1% on Nov 4 to $143.07, trading between $141.18 and $151.84; there is no 100-day yet (83 sessions). It is below the rising 5-day ($150.6) and 10-day ($147.4) and the falling 30-day ($162.1) averages. MACD has been above its signal since Oct 28, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 28 ($134.18), and RSI is 42.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 11月4日下跌 5.1%，收于 $143.07，盘中区间 $141.18–151.84；上市仅 83 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于上行的 5 日（$150.6）和 10 日均线（$147.4）以及下行的 30 日均线（$162.1）下方。MACD 自 10月28日起位于信号线上方，仍在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月28日起看多（$134.18），RSI 为 42。

read.en: The $151.84 high failed under the 5-day and Oct 14 high, and the close broke the $145.3–147.4 support (10-day, Oct 30 and Nov 2 lows), now resistance. Resistance is $145.3–147.4, then $150.6–152.4 (5-day, Nov 4 and Oct 14 highs) and $156.1–157.7. Support is $141.2–141.3, then $139.2–139.9 and $133.8–134.2 (SAR, Aug 7 low). A close above $147.4 would target $151–152; below $139.2, $134.

r.en: Oct 30 low $145.3; Nov 2 low $146.29; 10-day average $147.4, lost
Nov 2 high $156.06; Oct 28 low $156.5; Sep 3 low $157.7

bias.en: Rebound stalling · at the 10-day, ₩1.38 million held on close
bias.zh: 反弹停滞 · 位于 10 日均线，收盘守住 138 万韩元

read.en: SK hynix closed at ₩1,396,000 in the latest completed Seoul session, little changed from ₩1,398,000, ranging ₩1,303,000–1,476,000. It is just below the rising 10-day (₩1,398,600) and under the rising 5-day (₩1,416,000) and 200-day (₩1,506,425) and the falling 30-day (₩1,524,467) and 100-day (₩1,807,300). MACD has been above signal since Oct 27, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 26 (₩1,294,166), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: SK 海力士在最新完整的首尔交易日收于 ₩1,396,000，较前一收盘 ₩1,398,000 基本持平，盘中区间 ₩1,303,000–1,476,000。股价略低于上行的 10 日均线（₩1,398,600），并位于上行的 5 日（₩1,416,000）和 200 日均线（₩1,506,425）以及下行的 30 日（₩1,524,467）和 100 日均线（₩1,807,300）下方。MACD 自 10月27日起位于信号线上方，仍在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月26日起看多（₩1,294,166），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The ₩1,303,000 low dipped through the ₩1,358,000–1,381,000 supports, but the close recovered above them; the ₩1,476,000 high stalled under ₩1,495,000. Resistance is ₩1,398,600–1,416,000 (10 and 5-day), then ₩1,433,000–1,449,000 and ₩1,476,000–1,506,425 (200-day). Support is ₩1,379,000–1,381,000, then ₩1,358,000 and ₩1,294,000–1,303,000 (SAR). A close above ₩1,416,000 would target ₩1.43–1.45 million; below ₩1,379,000, ₩1.36 million.
